gloss: to start (an activity); to get involved in; to engage in

definitions.gloss: to start; to begin; to get involved in (an activity)
definitions.explanation: To begin engaging in an activity or field. Can be neutral but often carries a negative connotation when referring to undesirable activities.

definitions.gloss: to get one's hands dirty; to become involved in (wrongdoing)
definitions.explanation: To become implicated in or start participating in illegal, immoral, or undesirable activities.

examples.english: I got into theater during my student days.

notes:
IDIOM STRUCTURE:
⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (hand) + ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ + ⟦{染|そ}める→染める：04253_someru⟧ (to dye)

Literally "to dye one's hands" - implies getting deeply involved in something, as if the activity has stained one's hands.

USAGE:
- Can be neutral when referring to arts, hobbies, or professions
- Often negative when referring to illegal or immoral activities
- Suggests deep involvement, not superficial engagement
- The "dye" metaphor implies lasting involvement that's hard to wash away

COMMON PATTERNS:
〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{手|て}を{染|そ}める - to get involved in ~

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{手|て}を{染|そ}める - to get involved in crime
- ⟦{悪事|あくじ}→悪事：29054_akuji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{手|て}を{染|そ}める - to engage in wrongdoing
- ⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{手|て}を{染|そ}める - to get into politics
- ⟦{芸術|げいじゅつ}→芸術：02712_geijutsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{手|て}を{染|そ}める - to take up art

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{手|て}を{出|だ}す→手を出す：22776_tewodasu⟧ - to get involved in (also often negative)
- ⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{突|つ}っ{込|こ}む→突っ込む：07000_tsukkomu⟧ - to stick one's nose into
- ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{踏|ふ}み{入|い}れる - to step into, to enter (a field)

REGISTER:
Neutral to literary. Common in written Japanese and dramatic contexts.
